frameworks.title: Verb goes LAST
frameworks.body: Punjabi is Subject–Object–Verb, like Urdu and Hindi. 'I water drink' is the natural order.

frameworks.title: Shahmukhi = Urdu script for Punjabi
frameworks.body: Pakistani Punjabi uses Shahmukhi — almost the same letters as Urdu. If you can read Urdu, you can read this.

frameworks.title: Sister of Urdu
frameworks.body: Punjabi and Urdu share huge amounts of grammar and vocabulary. Learning one helps the other.
